newsitem.title: USA: US Mint buys 1.9 mln kg shg zinc at avg $1.4123/kg.
newsitem.headline: US Mint buys 1.9 mln kg shg zinc at avg $1.4123/kg.

text.p: The U.S. Mint said Wednesday that it bought a total of 1.9 million kg of special high grade zinc from three firms at an average price of $1.4123 per kg.
It said it bought 1.05 million kg of zinc from Phoenixx International in three lots at an average price of $1.4084 per kg and 646,000 kg of zinc from Ore & Chemical Co at $1.4179 per kg.
The final 204,000 kg of zinc were purchased from Hochschild Partners at $1.4161 per kg, the Mint said.
The total purchase price of the zinc was $2,683,667.80, the Mint said.
